name: English – UK commercial lease
description: UK commercial lease. Principal rent per annum, service charge, rent review, Landlord and Tenant Act 1954 and break clauses.
author: liteAECO

fields.label: Landlord
fields.description: Name after Landlord / Lessor, same or next line. Must start with a capital.

fields.label: Tenant
fields.description: Name after Tenant / Lessee, same or next line.

fields.label: Premises / Address
fields.description: Text after Premises / Property / Address (optionally 'known as') up to a UK postcode (e.g. EC2A 4NE).

fields.label: Permitted use
fields.description: Rest of the line after Permitted use / Use / Purpose, up to the first full stop.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Number + unit. Group 0 keeps the unit so sq ft is converted to m² in the derived panel.

fields.label: Principal rent (GBP)
fields.description: First £ amount after Principal rent / Annual rent / Base rent. Same line. Usually PER ANNUM in UK leases.

fields.label: Total (GBP)
fields.description: First £ amount after Total / Gross / Aggregate. Same line.

fields.label: Service charge (GBP)
fields.description: First £ amount after Service charge / Outgoings / Insurance rent. Same line.

fields.label: Rent deposit (GBP)
fields.description: First £ amount after Deposit / Rent deposit / Guarantee. Same line.

fields.label: VAT number
fields.description: UK VAT registration: GB 123 4567 89 or GB123456789.

fields.label: VAT
fields.description: Only checks presence. Check whether the landlord has opted to tax.
fields.pattern: \bVAT\b|Value Added Tax|option to tax|opted to tax

fields.label: Term commencement date
fields.description: Date after commencement keywords. Accepts 01/06/2026, 1 June 2026, 1st June 2026, June 1, 2026, 2026-06-01.
fields.pattern: (?:Term commencement date|Commencement date|commencing on|commence on|starts on|from and including)[\s:]*(\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+[A-Za-z]+\s+\d{4}|[A-Za-z]+\s+\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?,?\s+\d{4}|\d{1,2}[\/\.-]\d{1,2}[\/\.-]\d{2,4}|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})

fields.label: Term (years)
fields.description: Years after Term / Contractual term / Duration. Fallback: any 'N years'.

fields.label: Notice period (months)
fields.description: Months after notice / break keywords. Same line. UK leases often state 6 months' notice for a break.
fields.pattern: (?:Notice period|months'? (?:prior )?(?:written )?notice|notice of not less than|Break notice)[^\n]*?(\d+)\s*(?:month|months)

fields.label: Exclusivity
fields.description: Sentence starting at Exclusivity / Non-compete / Restrictive covenant.

fields.label: Underletting / Assignment
fields.description: Sentence starting at Underlet / Sublet / Assign / Alienation.
